description: This file is a PHP source code defining a controller class for customer reports in the OpenCart admin extension. It includes methods for displaying customer report forms, listing, saving report settings, and generating report data.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Controller class for managing customer reports in the OpenCart admin extension.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the display of the customer report form page, setting up breadcrumbs and loading necessary controllers and views.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the report configuration settings, verifying permissions and returning a JSON response.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Generates the customer report page, loads report data, and sets up pagination and filters.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Fetches report data based on filters such as date range and grouping, returning HTML view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs a list of reports (or report data) via response.
